answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 49 POA per identity, released only after 14 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 890 fakes must lock 43610 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The wander of the hostage is the deterrent, the umber of the slow release is the filter, and the karst of the burn is the punishment.
